text:
sam: quick follow-up from the RFC review: we still need to pick a canonical pin shape before next week's rollout
anika: agreed. i posted two small examples in the doc but paste them here for quick iteration
jorge: please do, easier inline
sam: option 1 = lease (hard reservation semantics)
sam: {"pin_id":"model-x:2026-04-01", "type":"lease", "lease_secs":43200, "owner":"svc-realtime"}
sam: semantics: control-plane enforces expiry; runtime treats expired lease as no longer binding
priya: +simple, but causes spike at expiry unless staggered leases
anika: option 2 = affinity/soft-ttl (prefer-but-not-enforce)
anika: {"pin_id":"model-x:2026-04-01", "type":"affinity", "soft_ttl_secs":604800, "affinity_score":0.8, "fallbacks":["model-x-quant"]}
jorge: affinity reduces sharp re-resolves, but routers need decay logic and more memory per route
priya: backward compat: older SDKs only understand lease. can runtime handle both?
sam: proposal: allow hybrid pins with both fields present. lease wins for hard requests, affinity used for preference otherwise
jorge: tradeoff: metadata blob size up. compacting hints matters for hot path lookups
anika: idea: keep canonical fields minimal (pin_id, content_hash, type) and attach an optional compressed hints blob referenced by key
ops: billing note: if tenant wants guaranteed capacity they must create a lease pin; affinity pins are advisory and do not reserve hardware
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: rollout/2026-04-02 -> tenant-99 (canary 5%)
priya: we also need rollout phase fields so control plane can expose metrics (canary/gradual/stable/deprecated)
sam: suggest: rollout_phase, canary_pct, deprecation_ts, health_signal_threshold, telemetry_tag
anika: sample combined shape (inline):
```
{
  "pin_id":"model-x@sha256:abc123",
  "alias":"v2.0.0",
  "type":"affinity",
  "lease_secs":0,
  "soft_ttl_secs":2592000,
  "affinity_score":0.9,
  "fallbacks":["model-x-quant","model-x-v1"],
  "rollout_phase":"gradual",
  "canary_pct":5,
  "health_signal_threshold":0.02,
  "provenance":"deploy-2026-04-02",
  "telemetry_tag":"eval/2026-04-02/promptset-12"
}
```
jorge: edge case: what if lease expires before soft_ttl? which takes precedence?
sam: convention: lease is authoritative until it expires; soft_ttl governs preference after lease expiry. document precedence clearly
priya: content-hash vs semver: runtime should trust content-hash; control plane can map semver aliases to hashes
anika: storage layout hint: index by (tenant, model_name) -> sorted active pins. resolver scans newest->oldest and applies precedence rules
ops: emit metrics: pin_count_by_type, avg_affinity_score, pins_expiring_per_hour. add dashboard panel for expiry churn
jorge: tests: unit for resolver precedence, load sim for expiry spike, chaos test for control-plane outage to observe affinity decay behavior
priya: policy question: tenant pins vs org pins vs global pins — current plan: tenant > org > global (more specific wins)
sam: any objections to mixed-fields canonical shape (minimal hot-path keys + optional hints)?
anika: +1 with docs on hot-path minimality
jorge: +1, i'll add the schema example and test plan to the RFC follow-up
priya: +1 from QA. will coordinate on chaos tests and telemetry mapping
sam: great. i'll update the RFC, add the resolver precedence table, and schedule a 20m sync after patch PRs land :thumbsup:
